class.name: OpenXRSpatialContainerSelfRenderingExtension
class.brief_description: OpenXR extension that defines "self rendering" for spatial containers.
class.description: OpenXR extension that defines "self rendering" for spatial containers. A self rendered spatial container's pixels are all generated by an app and submitted to the runtime using standard OpenXR swapchains and composition layers.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if spatial container self rendering is enabled in the project settings and available on the current runtime.
